info.title: Smartist API
info.description:
Song catalogue, setlists, gigs and booking CRM for bands. Each band (workspace) is addressed by its slug in the `{band}` path segment; `GET /api/config` returns it.

**Auth**: send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is a session token from `POST /api/login` (email + password) or from Google sign-in. Roles: `viewer` (read), `member` (edit), `admin` (settings, members, uploads).

**A workspace is private.** Reads need a session too, except where the band opted in: *public catalogue* opens songs and gigs; *public stage links* open a single setlist and a single song. Both are off by default. Operations that can be public list an empty security requirement next to `bearerAuth`.

IDs in request bodies (`song_ids`, `gig_id`, `venue_id`, `organizer_id`) must belong to the same band; anything else is refused with 400.

bearerAuth.description: Session token from login or Google sign-in

comment.description: Private note — omitted for visitors without a session

language.description: Language code (EN, DE, …); a linked GEMA work's language shadows it

has_lyrics.description: Whether the song has lyrics. Lists never carry the text; GET /api/{band}/songs/{id} returns it as `lyrics`, and GET /api/{band}/songs?lyrics=1 adds it to the list (CSV export).

extra.description: Free-form per-song data (`capo`, `isrc`, `listenUrl`, `sheetUrl`, `playbackUrl`, `referenceUrl`, `songinfoUrl`, …). Keys ending in `Url` must be http(s); a URL into the storage bucket is only accepted when the upload flow stored it. `lyrics` and `language` sent here by older clients are moved to their own fields.

play_count.description: Number of distinct setlists this song appears in

tags.description: Theme tags; trimmed, deduplicated case-insensitively, matched to the band's existing spelling. Omit to keep the stored tags, null or [] clears them.

setlist_titles.description: Titles of the setlists linked to this gig (empty string for an untitled one). Gig list, members only.

location.description: Free-text location when no venue is linked

comment.description: Private note — omitted for visitors without a session

venue_id.description: Must be one of this band's venues

organizer_id.description: Must be one of this band's organizers

gig_id.description: Must be one of this band's gigs

song_ids.description: Ordered song IDs (position = array index); every ID must be one of this band's songs

song_data.description: Snapshot of the song (or file event details) at the time of the action

Venue.description: CRM venue. Carries contact data (`contact_name`, `phone`, `generic_email`), so it is never public.

401.description: No valid session for this band

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Band slug — required unless the deployment is pinned to one band (`ARTIST_SLUG`)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: `health`: post-deploy check — `{ ok, missing, warnings, database, schema, schemaVersion }` (variable names only, never values); 503 when a required variable is missing, the database does not answer, or it lacks the newest migration. The other account and band actions have their own paths (`/api/auth/*`, `/api/signup/*`, `/api/config/*`).

get.description: Band slug, name, branding config, plan and usage. `songs` and `counts` are included only with a session or when the band has a public catalogue. `role` is the caller's role in this band (null without a session). The `slug` is the `{band}` path parameter for every other endpoint.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Band slug — required unless the deployment is pinned to one band (`ARTIST_SLUG`)

patch.description: Admin role. `config` is merged into the stored settings (keys not sent are kept); `plan` and `upgradedAt` are ignored — the plan changes only through `/api/config/upgrade` and `/downgrade`. `logoUrl` / `faviconUrl` must be http(s) and, when they point into the app's storage, this band's own uploads. Settings are capped at 64 KB.

403.description: Role too low for this action

post.description: Emails a 30-minute link to set a new password; the password is set on every account of the address. Always returns `{ ok: true }`, whether or not the address has an account. Rate-limited per IP and per address.

Email + password login. The address is the identity across workspaces: every account for it is tried and the response lists the bands it belongs to. Returns a session token for `Authorization: Bearer`, valid 8 hours (30 days with `rememberMe`). Changing or resetting the password ends every earlier session. Rate-limited per IP and per address.

get.description: With a session: every non-deleted song with play stats, as an array. Without a session only when the band has a public catalogue — then paged (`limit` ≤ 30, `offset`, `active=0` to include inactive songs) and returned as `{ rows, total, limit, offset }`.

get.description: Returns the Google authorization URL and sets a nonce cookie. Google returns to `/auth/callback`, which sets a short-lived `oauth_session` cookie and redirects to `/login`; `POST /api/auth/oauth-session` redeems it.

Returns the Facebook authorization URL and sets a nonce cookie. Facebook returns to `/auth/callback`, which sets a short-lived `oauth_session` cookie and redirects to `/login`; `POST /api/auth/oauth-session` redeems it.

post.description: Redeems the HttpOnly `oauth_session` cookie set by `/auth/callback` once and clears it. No session ever travels in a URL.
Ends every session of the signed-in address, on all devices and workspaces.

post.description: Redeems the link from `/api/auth/request-reset` (`token` and `hint` from its URL) and signs in. The password is set on every account of the address and earlier sessions end.
